title: Tracecat 1.1.0-alpha.1
body_markdown:
## Case management


- fix(cases): Scroll wide markdown tables in descriptions and comments ([#3534](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3534) )


## Tables


- feat(tables): Add resumable chunking for long text ([#3512](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3512) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Classify registry lock failures as registry errors ([#3506](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3506) )
- fix(agents): Classify preparation permission denials ([#3537](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3537) )
- feat(mcp): Nudge preset agent usage ([#3554](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3554) )
- fix(agents): Preserve cancellation after cleanup timeout ([#3555](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3555) )


## Tracecat MCP


- fix(mcp): Allow clearing output_type in update_agent_preset ([#3526](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3526) )
- feat(mcp): Action addressing and per-action execution results ([#3544](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3544) )


## Engine


- feat(engine): Add org-gated per-action toggle to disable secret error withholding ([#3497](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3497) )
- fix(engine): Retry truncated S3 downloads during materialization ([#3521](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3521) )
- fix(engine): Compile dependencies to reduce activity inputs ([#3536](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3536) )
- fix(engine): Classify invalid for_each expressions as user errors ([#3548](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3548) )
- fix(engine): Avoid registry cache scans after warm actions ([#3549](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3549) )


## API


- feat(api+ui): Show IP, user agent and last seen in organization sessions ([#3501](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3501) )
- feat(api+ui): Add per-organization IP allowlist ([#3502](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3502) )
- docs(api): Document organization IP allowlist and session visibility ([#3509](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3509) )
- fix(api): Allow templated preset and alias refs in workspace sync export ([#3519](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3519) )
- feat(api): Add workflow draft read/replace endpoints ([#3522](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3522) )
- feat(api): Return resource bodies from create and update endpoints ([#3523](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3523) )
- fix(api): Tighten validation and response contracts for Terraform ([#3525](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3525) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Restore Tailwind peer/group variants dropped by selector parser ([#3524](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3524) )
- fix(ui): Show chat panel divider and widen its drag target ([#3551](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3551) )


## Documentation


- docs: Align hosted MCP server count ([#3543](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3543) )


## Fixes


- fix(build): Point 0.0.0.0 error message to existing docs page ([#3533](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3533) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0...1.1.0-alpha.1](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0...1.1.0-alpha.1)
